name: Overhead Styled Grid
description: A true bird's-eye flat-lay on a styled seamless surface, the product placed with graphic-design precision inside a loose grid of complementary props — a different overhead register from the single wood-table flat-lay, styled for a broader range of verticals.
lighting: Flat even overhead light, soft true shadows
subject: product
prompt: shot directly from overhead at a true bird's-eye angle, the product placed off-center within a loosely gridded arrangement on a seamless matte surface in a single muted neutral tone, two or three small complementary props relevant to the product's own category placed with graphic-design intent at consistent spacing rather than scattered randomly, flat even overhead lighting casting soft true-to-life shadows straight down with no harsh directional streaking, a clean generous negative-space margin left open on one side, genuine material texture on the surface and props, no text, no logos beyond what is already printed on the product itself, no hands, no motion blur, immaculate editorial flat-lay clarity
